uiText_hotkeyDlgPadFail: ⚠ No gamepad found, please check the connection
uiText_hotkeyDlgPadDisallowed: This button can't be used in this mode, please press another button
uiText_gamepadHotkeyEnableHint: Only detects gamepad hotkeys when checked (off by default); even if "Gamepad Hold" or "Gamepad Combo" below is enabled, it won't take effect while this is off. "Gamepad Hold" = a single button must be held past a custom duration to trigger. "Gamepad Combo" = the left modifier button (shoulder/Start/Menu) held + the right main button (excluding stick-click buttons) pressed together to trigger. Trigger buttons can't be assigned directly as a hotkey; to use a trigger pull as a hotkey, remap it to a gamepad button or keyboard key first with a tool like JoyToKey.
uiText_conflictDescCtrlEsc: Ctrl+Esc: same as the Windows key, opens the Start menu
uiText_hkMainFrame: Hotkey Settings (click "Set", then press the key/button on the device)
uiText_hintMsg: Select a font from the list on the left to apply it automatically.
uiText_slot3Desc: Map place names, popup text, remaining UI…
uiText_glyphXAlignHint: Only affects glyphs whose black box is narrower than the cell (punctuation, small kana, etc.); regular CJK ideographs are unaffected
uiText_glyphXAlignRuleC: Rule C (force-center a specific punctuation list)
uiText_glyphXAlignCCharsHint: Rule C is for people who feel certain marks just aren't centered enough
uiText_asciiRenderHint: Apply a custom font to half-width alphanumeric characters; disable to use the game's native font
uiText_menuqueHint: Fixes CJK delimiter misdetection (MenuQue text such as loot menus) (only needed when not using UTF-8)
uiText_lootmenuHint: Fixes loot menu slot7/8 garbled text; requires MenuQue above to be enabled first (only needed when not using UTF-8)
uiText_texswapHint: Debug use — disables all CJK and custom ASCII fonts when on, falling back to the game's native fonts
uiText_debuglogHint: When off, the log only shows whether hooks applied successfully; when on, detailed diagnostics are also printed
uiText_gamepadInputDiagHint: When on, logs every gamepad button pressed during gameplay to verify gamepad hotkey detection is working; the first log line records which gamepad is currently connected
uiText_pathDiagHint: When on, prints CJK font substitution catch/miss messages; the value on the right is each path's own print-line cap, for debugging
uiText_lootmenuDiagHint: When on, prints hit messages for the loot menu slot7/8 garbled-text fix; the value on the right is the print-line cap, for debugging
uiText_hangWatchdogHint: If the UI freezes for more than 5 seconds, automatically dumps every thread's call stack to obCJK_iniEdit_hang.log, for diagnosing hard-to-reproduce hangs
uiText_linebreakSpacePathaLbl: PATH A: change line-break "-" to space:
uiText_linebreakSpacePathaHint: Forced line breaks use a space (0x20) instead of inserting "-" (0x2D)
uiText_linebreakSpacePathbcLbl: PATH B/C: change line-break "-" to space:
uiText_linebreakSpacePathbcHint: Also applies the space substitution to PATH B (console) / C (books)
uiText_saveDiagHint: When off, only logs each save/delete's success or failure (with a short reason on failure); when on, prints full diagnostic detail, for debugging
